integrity: The statements are supported by a self-contained combinatorial proof and two independently implemented finite checkers. No numerical priority is claimed for the classical Lah numbers or OEIS A000262.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a single repeated delimiter and individually labeled singleton payload symbols under contiguous length-one and length-two counts. No claim for several repeated symbols, cyclic/noisy reads, or longer factors.
title: Lah-list classification and a dominant fiber for repeated-delimiter bigram observations
